blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Toledo Xignex Trojans will field a revamped lineup in the 2026 Wesley So Cup while retaining several key holdovers from their previous campaigns. Grand Master (GM) Rogelio Barcenilla, International Masters (IM) Kim Steven Yap, Rico Mascarinas, and Joel Pimentel will remain with the Trojans. They will also welcome homegrown Cebuano GM Enrico Sevillano as their import for the tournament. Sevillano is currently based in the United States.
